defs.name: Copper
defs.text: +1 Coin.

defs.name: Silver
defs.text: +2 Coins.

defs.name: Gold
defs.text: +3 Coins.

defs.name: Platinum
defs.text: +5 Coins.

defs.name: Potion
defs.text: +1 Potion.

defs.name: Estate
defs.text: 1 Victory Point.

defs.name: Duchy
defs.text: 3 Victory Points.

defs.name: Province
defs.text: 6 Victory Points.

defs.name: Colony
defs.text: 10 Victory Points.

defs.name: Curse
defs.text: -1 Victory Point.

defs.name: Cellar
defs.text: +1 Action. Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.

defs.name: Chapel
defs.text: Trash up to 4 cards from your hand.

defs.name: Village
defs.text: +1 Card. +2 Actions.

defs.name: Smithy
defs.text: +3 Cards.

defs.name: Workshop
defs.text: Gain a card costing up to 4 Coins.

defs.name: Remodel
defs.text: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to 2 Coins more than it.

defs.name: Mine
defs.text: You may trash a Treasure from your hand. Gain a Treasure to your hand costing up to 3 Coins more than it.

defs.name: ExactTwoTest
defs.text: Test-only card: choose exactly two cards to trash.

defs.name: RepeatChooseTest
defs.text: Test-only card: repeat a program containing a choice.

defs.name: Merchant
defs.text: +1 Card. +1 Action. The first time you play a Silver this turn, +1 Coin.

defs.name: Militia
defs.text: +2 Coins. Each other player discards down to 3 cards in hand.

defs.name: Witch
defs.text: +2 Cards. Each other player gains a Curse.

defs.name: Moat
defs.text: +2 Cards. When another player plays an Attack card, you may first reveal this from your hand to be unaffected by it.

defs.name: Bureaucrat
defs.text: Gain a Silver onto your deck. Each other player reveals a Victory card from their hand and puts it onto their deck, or reveals a hand with no Victory cards.

defs.name: OrderAlphaTest
defs.text: Test-only trigger card: alpha ordering probe.

defs.name: OrderBetaTest
defs.text: Test-only trigger card: beta ordering probe.

defs.name: OrderGammaTest
defs.text: Test-only trigger card: gamma ordering probe.

defs.name: Market
defs.text: +1 Card. +1 Action. +1 Buy. +1 Coin.

defs.name: Festival
defs.text: +2 Actions. +1 Buy. +2 Coins.

defs.name: Laboratory
defs.text: +2 Cards. +1 Action.

defs.name: Gardens
defs.text: Worth 1 Victory Point per 10 cards you have, rounded down.

defs.name: Moneylender
defs.text: You may trash a Copper from your hand for +3 Coins.

defs.name: Poacher
defs.text: +1 Card. +1 Action. +1 Coin. Discard a card per empty Supply pile.

defs.name: Vassal
defs.text: +2 Coins. Discard the top card of your deck. If it is an Action card, you may play it.

defs.name: Harbinger
defs.text: +1 Card. +1 Action. Look through your discard pile. You may put a card from it onto your deck.

defs.name: Throne Room
defs.text: You may play an Action card from your hand twice.

defs.name: Council Room
defs.text: +4 Cards. +1 Buy. Each other player draws a card.

defs.name: Artisan
defs.text: Gain a card to your hand costing up to 5 Coins. Put a card from your hand onto your deck.

defs.name: Bandit
defs.text: Gain a Gold. Each other player reveals the top 2 cards of their deck, trashes a revealed Treasure other than Copper, and discards the rest.

defs.name: Library
defs.text: Draw until you have 7 cards in hand, skipping any Action cards you choose to; set those aside, discarding them afterwards.

defs.name: Sentry
defs.text: +1 Card. +1 Action. Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Trash and/or discard any number of them. Put the rest back on top in any order.
